qr_code_login.description: Upload the QR Code photo and enter its PIN: that is all. No photo at hand? The [QR Code reader]({qr_reader_url}) turns one into JSON, in your browser, without sending it anywhere. A QR Code lasts ten minutes and works once.

data_description.qr_code_image: A photo of the screen, or a screenshot. Read on this Home Assistant, nothing is sent out.
data_description.qr_code_pin: The four digits you typed in Pronote when the QR Code was displayed.

reauth_confirm.description: Your Pronote credentials have expired. Upload a fresh QR Code photo and enter its PIN. The [QR Code reader]({qr_reader_url}) can turn a photo into JSON if this Home Assistant cannot read it.

data_description.qr_code_image: A photo of the screen, or a screenshot. Read on this Home Assistant, nothing is sent out.
data_description.qr_code_pin: The four digits you typed in Pronote when the QR Code was displayed.

error.invalid_qr_image: Unreadable photo, or no Pronote QR Code found in it
error.qr_code_required: Provide the QR Code photo or its JSON
error.qr_decoder_missing: No QR decoder installed on this Home Assistant; paste the QR Code JSON instead
error.qr_code_rejected: Pronote refused this QR Code: wrong PIN, or the QR Code has expired or was already used. Generate a new one in Pronote — it lasts ten minutes and works once.
error.ip_suspended: Pronote has suspended this IP address after too many login attempts. Wait about fifteen minutes before trying again — retrying now only makes it last longer.

data.nickname: Define a nickname for your child

reauth.title: Re-authenticate
reauth.description: Your Pronote session has expired. Please re-enter your credentials to restore access.

rate_limited.title: Pronote API rate limited for {child_name}
rate_limited.description: Too many requests have been made to the Pronote API. The integration will automatically retry after the rate limit period expires.

connection_error.title: Pronote connection error for {child_name}
connection_error.description: Unable to connect to Pronote servers. This may be due to network issues or server maintenance. The integration will automatically retry.
